Simulate a SPLONGGET-like single-nucleus DNA data set

Source: R/simulate.R
simulate_scn.Rd

Simulate a SPLONGGET-like single-nucleus DNA data set

Usage

simulate_scn(
  n_cells = 200,
  genome = sim_genome(),
  sex = c("male", "female"),
  cell_types = c(normal = 0.6, tumour = 0.4),
  depth = c(meanlog = log(3000), sdlog = 0.35),
  events = sim_events_tumour(),
  private_frac = 0.05,
  multiplet_rate = 0.15,
  multiplet_sizes = c(`2` = 0.8, `3` = 0.2),
  peak_frac = 0.5,
  peak_sd = 200,
  access_sd = 0.5,
  wave_sd = 0.15,
  noise_phi = 0.25,
  frag_len = c(meanlog = log(700), sdlog = 0.6),
  snp_density = 1/2000,
  phase_block_mean = 1500000,
  switch_rate = 1e-04,
  block_flip_prob = 0,
  allele_error = 0.04,
  seed = 1
)

Arguments

n_cells

number of barcodes (cells) in the output

genome

bins table from sim_genome()

sex

"male" (chrX one copy, hap A) or "female"

cell_types

named numeric vector of type proportions

depth

lognormal parameters (meanlog, sdlog) of fragments per nucleus

events

data.table (chrom, start, end, cnA, cnB, type); type may be a cell type name or "private" (then private_frac of the nuclei carry it)

private_frac

fraction of nuclei carrying a "private" event

multiplet_rate

fraction of barcodes that are multi-nucleus pools

multiplet_sizes

sizes (number of nuclei) and their probabilities

peak_frac

fraction of fragments placed at accessibility peaks (0 = uniform placement within a bin)

peak_sd

spread (bp) of fragment starts around a peak

access_sd

log-sd of the shared per-bin accessibility

wave_sd

log-sd of the cell-type chromatin wave (2-5 Mb scale)

noise_phi

cell-private multiplicative noise (log-sd), autocorrelated over ~5 bins

frag_len

lognormal parameters of fragment length (bp)

snp_density

het SNPs per bp

phase_block_mean

mean phase-block length (bp)

switch_rate

per-SNP switch-error probability inside a block (1e-4 keeps a 750-SNP block mostly in one parity, attenuation ~0.93 by switch_attenuation(); 0.02 scrambles it)

block_flip_prob

probability that a block's orientation is flipped relative to the true haplotypes (0 = anchored blocks)

allele_error

per-observation allele error rate (ONT)

seed

RNG seed

Value

list with scn (an scn object, see new_scn()), truth (cells, nuclei, cn/cnA per nucleus, events), fragments (data.table in the Python fragments.tsv.gz layout, ps = phase set of the first covered SNP or -1, plus nucleus, copy, hap_true, hap, n_snps), snps (with hap_of_alt_true), params
